judgments.justification: “Under matched conditions” Gossamer-Seg had “lower median latency (29.4 ms vs 47.8 ms)” than Tumbril-3D.
It reports “lower 90th-percentile latency (33.1 ms vs 52.6 ms)” and “higher throughput (34.0 vs 20.9 scans/s).”
It gives test mIoU “67.9…vs 67.5%” and says the difference “was not statistically significant,” with p, CI, and n.
“Higher on car…cyclist…and pole, but lower on pedestrian…and vegetation” correctly reports the mixed per-class pattern.
It states the speed advantage occurred “despite higher analytical compute cost” and “more parameters,” correctly comparing both proxies.
It says published latencies “are not directly comparable” because of differing hardware, precision, batch size, and voxelisation handling, after using matched timing.
It reports matched Halcyon-G7, batch-1, 16-bit timing and “lower median latency (29.4 ms vs 47.8 ms)” plus throughput.
It reports “test mIoU (67.9…vs 67.5%)” and correctly states the paired difference “was not statistically significant.”
